messages:
lisa-support: FYI - customer Acme reporting analytics stale for >5h. Dashboards stop showing usage after 02:15 UTC. They’re on Dedicated. High priority from CS.
oncall-ingest: on it, pinging ingest-runbook and checking consumer lag. Do we have any alerts?
ingest-bot: [alert] usage-ingest.consumer-lag > 100k msgs for group=usage-consumer-prod (since 2026-06-18T02:40:00Z)
matt-eng: I can check the pipeline. Quick checks: Kafka offsets, latest commit for usage-etl, and downstream table watermark.
ravi-data: running quick query on events store to find latest timestamp for Acme:
```
SELECT MAX(received_at) AS last_event FROM raw_usage.events WHERE customer_id='acme';
```
results: 2026-06-18T02:15:12Z
olivia-pm: Customer impact: analytics & billing dashboards affected, watch for billing spikes once events replayed. CS needs ETA to tell Acme.
oncall-ingest: kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group usage-consumer-prod shows partition lag ~120k across 10 partitions. Consumer at offset behind producer.
matt-eng: Logs from usage-etl show repeated failures in the transform stage starting ~02:30 UTC: 
```
ERROR: KeyError: 'device_meta' at transform.py:87
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "worker.py", line 103, in <module>
    transformed = transform(record)
  File "transform.py", line 87, in transform
    return r['device_meta']['type']
KeyError: 'device_meta'
```
lisa-support: that smells like a schema change from producer. Any recent deploys?
ravi-data: I pulled the git history for the producer topic (mobile-sdk) - there was a permissive change at 01:50 UTC that started sending records without device_meta for some older SDKs. New validation should tolerate missing device_meta but transform assumes presence.
matt-eng: Ok we have two immediate mitigation options: 1) patch transform to default missing fields (hotfix) and restart workers, 2) run a one-off backfill after fixing transform so missed messages get applied. 
oncall-ingest: Hotfix would reduce ongoing failures and start draining lag. Backfill will replay ~120k msgs; estimate jobs runtime ~1.5-2h if we parallelize across 5 workers.
olivia-pm: CS needs ETA to update customer. Recommend hotfix + rolling restart now, backfill after.
ravi-data: I can push a small patch to transform.py to use .get and default device type to 'unknown'. Will open PR now.
matt-eng: Also need to ensure the ETL's schema migration didn't change downstream table layout. Quick check on warehouse:
```
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='metrics.events' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
```
shows expected schema, no missing col. Good.
ingest-bot: [deploy-bot] Started restart job usage-etl-prod (job id: job-87321)
matt-eng: After restart, monitoring consumer lag. If workers pick up, lag should drop steadily.
oncall-ingest: Lag trending: 120k -> 95k in 6m -> 40k in 18m. :thumbsup:
lisa-support: CS updated Acme: we told them we see an ingestion backlog and are restarting workers; initial ETA 2 hours to fully catch up.
olivia-pm: Note: we should schedule a postmortem item for stricter contract checks on mobile-sdk.
matt-eng: Backfill prep: we'll run the replay tool with --customer acme --max-parallel 5. Command: 
```
python tools/replay_kafka.py --topic=usage-events --from-offset=earliest --to-offset=latest --filter-customer=acme --parallel=5
```
ravi-data: I’ll own running that after we confirm workers stable. ETA for starting backfill: 30m from now. Estimated run time 1.5h.
oncall-ingest: After hotfix and restart, no new transform errors in logs. Consumer lag down to 8k and dropping.
lisa-support: customer replied, appreciated the quick update. Keep me posted if timeline changes. :eyes: 
matt-eng: Starting replay now (kickoff at 1768806800). Monitoring job logs and warehouse writes.
ravi-data: Replay progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 70m. Warehouse watermark updated to 2026-06-18T07:05:00Z. Dashboards refreshed.
olivia-pm: Closing loop: root cause = producer SDK change + transform assumption. Action items: enforce schema contract, add guard in transform, add integration test for missing device_meta, run customer-facing postmortem in 48h.
lisa-support: Closing thread for now — analytics for Acme back to normal. Will reopen if any regression. :white_check_mark:
